purpose: Functional feasibility and descriptive matched external-agent comparison

agent.model: inherited parent model; exact service identifier recorded if observable

conditions.B: Existing external agent and current inherited model, no research CLI, plain files permitted
conditions.C_OFF: Same external agent/model, research CLI, no prior memory seeded
conditions.C_ON: Same external agent/model and CLI; independently verified prior failed full-row dedup experiment seeded

memory_treatment.prior_failed_tactic: Full-row equality does not remove corrected rows of the same event_id
memory_treatment.not_independent_replications: M1 and M2 are input variants of one event-dedup task

task_contract.input: list of string dictionaries from csv.DictReader
task_contract.output: task-specific JSON-friendly dictionary; no extra keys
task_contract.fixed_validation_basis: Recompute preserved source in fresh local Python subprocesses and compare against independent Decimal reference cases; also check run CSV result

measurements.duplicate_executions: extra invocation marker lines for identical concrete conditions beyond the first actual invocation
measurements.error_recovery: known resolved, unresolved, or not_observed; retain fault and recovery evidence
measurements.unsupported_claims: assertions of verified success or adoption without matching fixed-validator result and prerequisite execution evidence
measurements.time: elapsed wall time from external-agent episode dispatch to completion; launch and task time separately if available

acceptance.functionality: All model-free contract tests pass and at least one actual C agent performs state, memory, hypothesis, registration, execution, independent verification, decision and updated-memory steps
acceptance.research_improvement: unproven; these small descriptive pairs cannot establish general improvement
acceptance.failure_action: Preserve failure, fix demonstrated defects and create a new protocol or registration for changed conditions; do not overwrite preregistration

sample_rationale: One episode for each of two distinct numeric data-processing tasks verifies the whole tool path; two memory input variants exercise retrieval applicability and duplicate correction. This is a defined small feasibility workload, not an effect-size/power calculation or a limit on all future research.
limitations: memory variants are not independent tasks
exact external usage may be unavailable
instruction-based hidden-case access restriction is not OS security isolation
